news.titleEn: Iran Warns of Hormuz Ship Seizures Ahead of Bessent's Planned Sanctions Push
news.conclusionEn: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent launched "Operation Economic Outcast," an escalating sanctions campaign he called an "economic D-Day" meant to sever Iran's global financial lifelines and reopen the Strait of Hormuz.
news.conclusionZh: 美财长贝森特启动「经济流放行动」，称之为「经济诺曼底登陆」，意在切断伊朗的全球金融命脉并重开霍尔木兹海峡。
news.whyEn: The sanctions target shipping, oil, crypto, gold and aviation networks tied to Iran, raising the risk of retaliation in the Hormuz Strait — a chokepoint for roughly a fifth of global oil supply — which could spike energy prices worldwide.
news.whyZh: 制裁涉及与伊朗相关的航运、石油、加密货币、黄金及航空网络，可能招致伊朗在霍尔木兹海峡（承担全球约五分之一石油运输）报复，从而推高全球能源价格。
news.detailEn: Bessent announced Monday that the sanctions would target international entities facilitating Iranian trade in oil, shipping, crypto, gold and aviation, framing the campaign as the endgame after the two sides missed a 60-day ceasefire window. He said the goal was to sever "every economic lifeline" sustaining Tehran's government. In response, Iran's top security chief Mohsen Rezaei threatened to halt oil flow through the Strait of Hormuz if neighboring countries joined the US crackdown, while Iran's Persian Gulf Strait Authority warned vessels violating transit rules could face fines or seizure. The standoff comes as the US-Iran conflict, now in its sixth month, has already rattled oil and equity markets repeatedly this summer.
news.detailZh: 贝森特周一宣布，制裁将针对协助伊朗石油、航运、加密货币、黄金及航空贸易的国际实体，并将此次行动定性为双方错过60天停火窗口后的「终局之战」，目标是切断维系德黑兰政府的「每一条经济命脉」。作为回应，伊朗最高安全官员礼萨伊威胁称，若周边国家加入美国的制裁行动，伊朗将阻断霍尔木兹海峡的石油运输；伊朗波斯湾海峡管理局也警告，违反通行规定的船只可能面临罚款或扣押。这场对峙发生在已持续六个月的美伊冲突背景下，今夏石油与股市已多次因此受到冲击。

news.titleEn: Oil Holds Decline as US Ramps Up Economic Pressure on Iran
news.conclusionEn: Oil prices held a decline Monday as the US escalated economic pressure on Iran, with WTI trading near $85 a barrel and Brent around $92 after both benchmarks fell more than 2% the prior session.
news.conclusionZh: 美国加大对伊朗经济施压，油价周一维持跌势，WTI报每桶85美元附近，布伦特约92美元，此前一交易日两者均跌超2%。
news.whyEn: Oil price swings driven by the Hormuz standoff ripple through inflation, transportation costs and consumer prices worldwide, making this one of the most closely watched market signals of the current Iran conflict.
news.whyZh: 受霍尔木兹海峡对峙影响的油价波动，将波及全球通胀、运输成本及消费者物价，是当前伊朗冲突中市场最关注的信号之一。
news.detailEn: Crude prices slipped as traders weighed the new US sanctions campaign against signs that a full closure of the Strait of Hormuz remains more threat than reality for now. WTI crude traded near $85 a barrel and Brent closed around $92, extending losses from the prior session's more-than-2% drop. Analysts said the market is pricing in elevated geopolitical risk premium while still assuming supply disruptions will be limited unless Iran follows through on threats to interfere with tanker traffic. Further price swings are expected as the sanctions campaign unfolds this week.
news.detailZh: 由于交易员在权衡美国新一轮制裁行动与霍尔木兹海峡「全面封锁」目前仍更多是威胁而非现实之间的关系，原油价格有所回落。WTI原油报每桶85美元附近，布伦特收于约92美元，延续了上一交易日跌幅超2%的走势。分析师表示，市场正在计入较高的地缘政治风险溢价，但仍假设除非伊朗真正干扰油轮通行，否则供应中断将是有限的。随着本周制裁行动的推进，预计油价还将继续波动。

news.titleEn: Here's What the Charts Say About Nvidia's Stock Heading Into Earnings
news.conclusionEn: Nvidia reports fiscal Q2 earnings Wednesday after the close, with Wall Street expecting revenue near $92 billion and adjusted EPS of $2.09, a result widely seen as a bellwether for the entire AI trade.
news.conclusionZh: 英伟达将于周三盘后公布第二财季财报，市场预期营收约920亿美元、调整后每股收益2.09美元，被视为整个AI交易的风向标。
news.whyEn: As the dominant supplier of AI accelerators, Nvidia's results and guidance — especially on China sales and data-center demand — could determine whether the recent chip-stock selloff deepens or reverses across the broader tech sector.
news.whyZh: 作为AI加速芯片的主导供应商，英伟达的业绩与指引（尤其是中国销售及数据中心需求）将决定近期芯片股抛售是否会在整个科技板块加剧或逆转。
news.detailEn: Nvidia is scheduled to report second-quarter fiscal 2027 results on Wednesday after markets close, with consensus estimates calling for roughly $92 billion in revenue, implying nearly 95% year-over-year growth, and adjusted earnings per share of $2.09. The company's own guidance excluded any China data-center revenue, so any updated commentary on China chip sales could move the stock sharply in either direction. The report comes amid a broader pullback in semiconductor shares over the past week, with investors trimming AI hardware exposure ahead of the print, making Wednesday's results a critical test of whether the AI infrastructure buildout narrative still holds.
news.detailZh: 英伟达定于周三美股收盘后公布2027财年第二季度业绩，市场普遍预期营收约920亿美元，同比增长近95%，调整后每股收益为2.09美元。公司此前指引并未计入任何中国数据中心营收，因此关于中国芯片销售的最新表态可能引发股价大幅波动。该财报发布之际，半导体股过去一周已出现回调，投资者在财报前减持AI硬件仓位，使周三的业绩成为检验AI基础设施建设叙事是否依然成立的关键节点。

news.titleEn: Netlist Files Patent Infringement Action Against Micron at US International Trade Commission
news.conclusionEn: Netlist filed ITC and federal court complaints accusing Micron of infringing four patents covering DDR5 server memory, seeking to block imports of Micron's DDR5 RDIMM and MRDIMM products.
news.conclusionZh: Netlist向美国国际贸易委员会及联邦法院起诉美光，指控其侵犯四项DDR5服务器内存专利，并寻求禁止相关产品进口。
news.whyEn: A successful exclusion order could disrupt supply of memory chips central to AI servers, adding legal risk on top of the recent chip-stock selloff and pressuring Micron shares, which fell nearly 6% on the news.
news.whyZh: 若禁止令生效，将扰乱AI服务器核心内存芯片的供应，在近期芯片股抛售之上再添法律风险，美光股价因此消息一度下跌近6%。
news.detailEn: Netlist's ITC complaint, filed August 12, names Micron along with Supermicro, HPE and Lenovo, alleging infringement of four patents related to DDR5 RDIMM and MRDIMM memory technology. A parallel federal lawsuit in the Central District of California asserts two of the same patents against Micron directly. Rather than seeking only monetary damages, Netlist is requesting exclusion and cease-and-desist orders that would block the import of the allegedly infringing products into the US, directly targeting memory lines central to Micron's AI server business. Micron shares slid on the news, compounding a broader selloff in memory and AI-chip stocks ahead of Nvidia's earnings this week.
news.detailZh: Netlist于8月12日向ITC提起申诉，将美光及美超微、HPE和联想一并列为被告，指控其侵犯四项与DDR5 RDIMM及MRDIMM内存技术相关的专利。加州中区联邦法院的平行诉讼则直接针对美光主张其中两项专利。Netlist并未仅寻求金钱赔偿，而是要求发布排除令和禁止进口令，阻止被控侵权产品进入美国市场，直接冲击美光AI服务器业务的核心内存产品线。消息公布后美光股价下跌，加剧了英伟达本周财报发布前内存与AI芯片股的整体抛售。

news.titleEn: Kevin Warsh to Make First Jackson Hole Speech as Fed Chair
news.conclusionEn: New Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh will deliver his first Jackson Hole keynote Friday, August 28, as markets look for clarity on how he will respond to inflation running near 3.4%, well above the Fed's 2% target.
news.conclusionZh: 美联储新任主席沃什将于8月28日周五发表其首场杰克逊霍尔主题演讲，市场期待其对逾3.4%的高通胀释放政策信号。
news.whyEn: First-time keynotes by a new Fed chair are historically market-moving — Powell's 2022 speech triggered a 3.4% single-day S&P 500 drop — and Warsh has so far avoided forward guidance, leaving investors uncertain about the rate path.
news.whyZh: 新任美联储主席的首场演讲历来对市场影响巨大——鲍威尔2022年的演讲曾致标普500单日暴跌3.4%——而沃什此前一直回避前瞻指引，令投资者对利率路径感到不确定。
news.detailEn: Warsh will speak at 10 a.m. ET on Friday at the Jackson Hole Economic Symposium, whose 2026 theme is "Financial Innovation: Implications for Payments and Policy," gathering roughly 120 central bankers and economists from more than 70 countries. Since taking over from Powell in May, Warsh has removed forward-looking guidance from FOMC statements in favor of a purely data-dependent approach, and after July's meeting he offered little insight into his rate views, which some investors read as a lack of resolve on inflation — a reaction that helped push long-term bond yields to two-decade highs. With inflation still elevated and signs of consumer stress raising recession concerns, Friday's speech is one of the few extended opportunities markets will get to hear directly from the new chair before the September 15-16 FOMC meeting.
news.detailZh: 沃什将于周五美东时间上午10点在杰克逊霍尔经济研讨会上发表演讲，本届主题为「金融创新：对支付与政策的影响」，约120位来自70多个国家的央行官员及经济学家将出席。自5月接替鲍威尔以来，沃什已从FOMC声明中移除前瞻指引，转而采取纯数据驱动的方式；7月会议后他对利率立场几乎未作说明，部分投资者将此解读为在通胀问题上缺乏决心，这一反应曾推动长期国债收益率升至二十年高位。在通胀仍居高不下、消费者压力迹象引发衰退担忧之际，周五的演讲将是市场在9月15-16日FOMC会议前少有的直接聆听新主席表态的机会。

news.titleEn: US Eyes China Overcapacity Tariffs of 7.5% Before Xi-Trump Talks
news.conclusionEn: The US is considering a new 7.5% tariff on Chinese goods over allegations of industrial overcapacity, ahead of anticipated further trade discussions between Presidents Trump and Xi.
news.conclusionZh: 美国正考虑对中国商品加征7.5%的「产能过剩」关税，此举发生在特朗普与习近平预期展开进一步贸易磋商之前。
news.whyEn: A new tariff would mark fresh friction just months after the two countries' May summit trade truce, and any escalation could ripple through global supply chains, manufacturing costs and equity markets already on edge over Fed policy and the Iran standoff.
news.whyZh: 在两国5月峰会达成贸易休战仅几个月后，新关税意味着摩擦再起，若局势升级，将波及全球供应链、制造成本及本已因美联储政策与伊朗对峙而承压的股市。
news.detailEn: According to Bloomberg News, the US is weighing a 7.5% tariff targeting Chinese goods linked to industrial overcapacity, a measure that would layer onto existing duties imposed during this year's trade disputes. The move comes as Washington and Beijing prepare for further high-level contact following their May summit, which had produced a truce reducing some tariffs and securing US access to critical minerals in exchange for a pledge to restore agricultural purchases. Whether the new tariff proceeds may hinge on the outcome of upcoming talks, with markets watching closely for signs of renewed escalation versus a durable truce.
news.detailZh: 据彭博社报道，美国正考虑对与「产能过剩」相关的中国商品加征7.5%关税，此举将叠加在今年贸易争端期间已实施的关税之上。此举正值华盛顿与北京在5月峰会后筹备进一步高层接触之际——此前的峰会曾达成休战，降低部分关税并确保美国获得关键矿产供应，以换取中方恢复农产品采购的承诺。新关税能否推进，或将取决于即将举行的会谈结果，市场正密切关注局势是会重新升级还是维持稳定休战。

news.titleEn: Nvidia, AMD, Micron Lead Chip Stocks Selloff as Iran Tensions Rattle Markets
news.conclusionEn: Chip stocks led Monday's market decline as Nvidia fell 2.4% and Micron dropped nearly 6% on patent and earnings jitters, even as the Dow eked out a 0.26% gain and hyperscalers Meta, Amazon and Alphabet each rose.
news.conclusionZh: 周一芯片股领跌，英伟达跌2.4%，美光因专利诉讼及财报前紧张情绪重挫近6%，但道指微涨0.26%，Meta、亚马逊、Alphabet等云计算巨头股价均上涨。
news.whyEn: The widening gap between falling chip-hardware stocks and rising cloud-hyperscaler stocks signals investors are growing more selective about which parts of the AI trade to trust, a divergence that could reshape sector positioning heading into Nvidia's earnings.
news.whyZh: 芯片硬件股下跌与云计算巨头股上涨之间的差距扩大，显示投资者对AI概念股的选择趋于谨慎，这一分化可能在英伟达财报公布前重塑板块资金布局。
news.detailEn: The S&P 500 fell 0.28% to 7,652.86 and the Nasdaq slid 0.76% to 25,980.19 on Monday, dragged down by semiconductor names as investors trimmed AI-hardware exposure ahead of Nvidia's Wednesday earnings and Micron faced fresh patent litigation from Netlist. Nvidia dropped 2.4%, while AMD and Broadcom each fell more than 2-3%. In contrast, hyperscalers Meta, Amazon and Alphabet gained between 0.9% and 1.7%, marking one of the widest single-session chip-versus-cloud divergences in recent weeks. Scott Bessent's newly announced Iran sanctions campaign added a macro overhang to the session, even as the Dow managed a slight 0.26% gain on strength in non-tech sectors.
news.detailZh: 周一标普500指数下跌0.28%，报7652.86点；纳斯达克综合指数下跌0.76%，报25980.19点，主要受半导体股拖累——投资者在英伟达周三财报公布前削减AI硬件持仓，同时美光又面临Netlist提起的新专利诉讼。英伟达下跌2.4%，AMD和博通跌幅均超过2%-3%。相比之下，云计算巨头Meta、亚马逊和Alphabet股价分别上涨0.9%至1.7%，形成近期芯片股与云计算股之间最明显的单日分化。贝森特新宣布的对伊制裁行动也为当日交易增添了宏观层面的压力，尽管道指凭借非科技板块的强势仍小幅上涨0.26%。

news.titleEn: Bitcoin and Ethereum Prices Rising as Investors Look for More Fed Clues This Week
news.conclusionEn: Bitcoin climbed toward $79,000 on Monday, its highest level since May, as traders looked ahead to Fed Chair Warsh's Jackson Hole speech and reacted to Trump's backing of crypto-friendly regulation.
news.conclusionZh: 比特币周一升至近79000美元，为5月以来最高水平，市场关注美联储主席沃什的杰克逊霍尔演讲，并受特朗普支持加密友好监管消息提振。
news.whyEn: Crypto's rally alongside anticipation of Fed policy signals shows how tightly digital-asset prices are now linked to US monetary policy and regulatory developments like the Clarity Act, which could reshape crypto oversight for years.
news.whyZh: 加密货币在美联储政策信号预期中同步上涨，显示数字资产价格已与美国货币政策及Clarity法案等监管进展高度绑定，后者可能长期重塑加密监管格局。
news.detailEn: Bitcoin opened around $77,700 on Monday and climbed toward $79,000 by late morning, extending a strong weekend that put it at its highest level since May, while ethereum reached its best level since late January. The rally was driven partly by optimism around President Trump's backing of the Clarity Act, which would clarify whether cryptocurrencies are regulated as securities or commodities, and partly by anticipation of Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's Jackson Hole speech this week. Analysts are now eyeing $80,000 as bitcoin's next resistance level, with some forecasts, including from Standard Chartered, projecting a run toward $100,000 by year-end if regulatory and monetary conditions stay favorable.
news.detailZh: 比特币周一开盘价约为77700美元，到临近中午已升至近79000美元，延续了周末以来的强势表现，创下5月以来新高，以太坊也升至1月底以来的最佳水平。此轮上涨部分受特朗普支持Clarity法案（旨在明确加密货币应按证券还是大宗商品监管）的乐观情绪推动，也受到市场对本周美联储主席沃什杰克逊霍尔演讲的预期提振。分析师目前将8万美元视为比特币的下一个阻力位，渣打银行等机构预测，若监管与货币环境保持有利，年底前有望冲击10万美元。

businessTips.explanationEn: Economies of scale occur when a company's average cost per unit falls as its production volume increases, because fixed costs like factories, equipment and software get spread across more units, and bulk purchasing lowers per-unit input costs. This is why larger companies can often underprice smaller rivals while still maintaining healthy margins. Understanding this concept helps explain why industries like manufacturing, cloud computing and retail tend to consolidate around a few large players, and why growing volume — not just revenue — is often a strategic priority.
businessTips.explanationZh: 规模经济是指企业随着产量增加，单位产品的平均成本随之下降，原因是工厂、设备和软件等固定成本被分摊到更多产品上，同时批量采购也降低了单位投入成本。这也是为什么大企业往往能以更低价格与小竞争对手竞争，同时仍保持健康利润率。理解这一概念有助于解释为什么制造业、云计算、零售等行业容易向少数大型企业集中，也说明为什么扩大产量（而不仅是营收）常被视为战略重点。
businessTips.exampleEn: A cloud storage company's cost per gigabyte drops sharply as it scales from 1,000 to 1 million customers, because the same data centers and engineering team now serve far more users. This lets it cut prices to attract more customers while competitors running smaller operations can't match the price without losing money.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一家云存储公司在用户规模从1000扩大到100万时，每GB存储成本大幅下降，因为同样的数据中心和工程团队现在服务了更多用户。这使它能够降价吸引更多客户，而规模较小的竞争对手若跟进降价则会面临亏损。

businessTips.explanationEn: A minimum viable product is the simplest version of a product that lets a founder test a core idea with real customers, gathering feedback before investing in full-featured development. The goal is to learn whether people actually want the product with the least amount of time and money spent, avoiding the common startup mistake of building something polished that nobody needs. An MVP can be as simple as a landing page, a manual service disguised as a product, or a bare-bones app with only one feature working. Speed to feedback matters more than polish at this stage.
businessTips.explanationZh: 最小可行产品（MVP）是指产品最精简的版本，用以让创始人用尽可能少的时间和金钱，向真实客户验证核心想法并收集反馈，避免创业中常见的「打磨出一个没人需要的产品」的失误。MVP可以简单到只是一个落地页、一个「人工代劳但包装成产品」的服务，或是只有一个功能能用的简陋App。在这一阶段，获得反馈的速度比打磨程度更重要。
businessTips.exampleEn: Before building a full meal-kit delivery app, a founder manually sources ingredients, packs boxes by hand, and delivers them personally to the first 20 customers using a simple sign-up form. If customers keep ordering, that validates demand before a single line of app code is written.
businessTips.exampleZh: 在开发完整的送餐包App之前，创始人先手动采购食材、亲自打包，并用一份简单的报名表单，亲自将餐盒送到最初20位客户手中。如果客户持续下单，就在还没写一行App代码之前验证了市场需求。

businessTips.explanationEn: Dollar-cost averaging is an investment strategy where a fixed amount of money is invested at regular intervals — such as monthly — regardless of whether prices are high or low, rather than trying to time the market with a single lump-sum purchase. This smooths out the average purchase price over time: buying more shares when prices are low and fewer when prices are high. The main benefit is removing emotion and guesswork from investing decisions, which is especially useful for volatile assets. It doesn't guarantee the best possible return, but it reduces the risk of investing a large sum right before a downturn.
businessTips.explanationZh: 定投（成本平均法）是一种投资策略，即按固定时间间隔（如每月）投入固定金额，无论当时价格高低，而不是试图通过一次性大额投入来精准择时。这样做能随时间平摊平均买入成本：价格低时买入更多份额，价格高时买入更少。其主要好处是消除投资决策中的情绪与猜测成分，对波动较大的资产尤为有用。它不能保证获得最佳收益，但能降低在下跌前重仓投入的风险。
businessTips.exampleEn: Instead of investing $12,000 in a stock all at once, an investor puts in $1,000 every month for a year. When the price drops mid-year, that month's $1,000 buys more shares than usual, lowering the investor's overall average cost per share compared to a single lump-sum purchase at the wrong time.
businessTips.exampleZh: 投资者没有一次性投入1.2万美元买入某只股票，而是选择每月投入1000美元，持续一年。年中股价下跌时，当月的1000美元能买到比平时更多的份额，从而拉低整体平均持仓成本，相比在错误时点一次性重仓买入更为稳健。
